title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Guaranty Percentages and Loan-Size Bands
content:
The guaranty VA issues on a loan under the VA Home Loan Guaranty is set by the size of the loan, in four bands: a loan of 45,000 dollars or less; a loan above 45,000 and up to 56,250 dollars; a loan above 56,250 and up to 144,000 dollars; and a loan above 144,000 dollars.

## Guaranty by band and program

| Program | Loan of 45,000 or less (% of loan) | Loan above 45,000 up to 56,250 (flat, USD) | Loan above 56,250 up to 144,000 (% of loan) | Most guaranty in that band (USD) | Loan above 144,000 (% of loan) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 50 | 22500.00 | 40 | 36000.00 | 25 |

The percentage on a loan above 144,000 dollars is subject to the veteran's remaining entitlement.

## Band edges

| Hypothetical loan amount | Band | Guaranty |
|---|---|---|
| 45,000.00 | 45,000 or less | 50 percent, 22500.00 |
| 45,000.01 | above 45,000 up to 56,250 | flat 22500.00 |
| 56,250.00 | above 45,000 up to 56,250 | flat 22500.00 |
| 56,250.01 | above 56,250 up to 144,000 | 40 percent, 22500.00 (rounded to the cent) |
| 144,000.00 | above 56,250 up to 144,000 | 40 percent is 57,600.00, held to the 36000.00 most |
| 144,000.01 | above 144,000 | 25 percent, 36000.00 (rounded to the cent), subject to remaining entitlement |
